info.name: Convert Files
info.summary: Convert files to other formats using CloudConvert
info.description:
CC Convert integrates the CloudConvert API directly into the Nextcloud Files interface.
Right-click any file to convert it to another format without ever leaving Nextcloud. Supported conversions include documents (PDF, DOCX, ODT), images (PNG, JPG, WEBP), and video/audio files (MP4, MP3, MOV).
Features: - Right-click context menu action on any file in Nextcloud Files - Format-aware conversion — available output formats are determined by the source file's extension - Clean in-browser modal for selecting the target format and tracking conversion progress - Admin configuration panel to securely store the CloudConvert API key - Converted file is automatically saved to the same folder as the original
Requirements: - A CloudConvert API key (https://cloudconvert.com/dashboard) - PHP curl extension enabled on the server
info.author: Schuyler "Rocky" Reidel, Reidel Law Firm
